# Knowledge Chat V2 ten-transaction anchor — must-not claims

Status: `owner_accepted_pending_independent_sme_review`; every example is synthetic and contains no customer data.

- The fixture is a read-only work-product answer key, never an ERP posting instruction.
- Do not claim that BRAVO executed, posted, approved, paid, reconciled, locked or registered an item.
- Do not make an exact BRAVO menu, screen, field, configuration or version claim unless an approved,
  effective and version-compatible evidence reference is attached.
- Do not infer tax eligibility, loan classification, salary accrual history or a partial-payment
  configuration from an arithmetic result.
- TT99/2025 uses account `3411` for this direct-bank loan fixture. A legacy `311` alternative must
  remain an explicit policy ambiguity, never a silent substitution.
- Missing guide evidence must be reported as a precise source gap while independently supported
  task units still appear in the answer.
